sloka: गोलभस्य महाबाहुः दश वर्षाणि पंच च ।न एव रात्रौ न दिवसे तत् युद्धम् उपशाम्यति ॥४-२२-२९॥
transliteration: golabhasya mahābāhuḥ daśa varṣāṇi paṁca ca ।na eva rātrau na divase tat yuddham upaśāmyati ॥4-22-29॥

translations.english: 'Great soul, Vali endowed with stout shoulders joined a duel with a gandharva called Golabha for fifteen years nonstop night and day.
